Inference server parameters

Every runtime parameter accepted by the completion endpoint, with the value range enforced by the validator.

Sampling

temperature
Scales the logits before softmax. Higher values flatten the distribution.
top_p
Nucleus sampling cutoff applied after temperature scaling.

Limits

ParameterTypeDefaultEnforced range
temperaturefloat0.70.0 to 2.0
top_pfloat0.950.0 to 1.0
max_tokensinteger40961 to 131072
frequency_penaltyfloat0.0-2.0 to 2.0
presence_penaltyfloat0.0-2.0 to 2.0
A value outside these ranges returns HTTP 400 before scheduling.

Request

curl https://api.example.com/v1/complete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"max_tokens": 4096, "temperature": 0.2}'
Why the range is narrower than the model's

The scheduler reserves headroom for the KV cache, so the advertised window exceeds what one request may claim.

Parameters are validated before the request reaches the scheduler.
